description:
This file defines the Listing class within the Goteo
amespace, which groups projects into sublists of a specified size (default 3), providing navigation links between these groups.

classes.name: Listing
classes.description: Provides a static method to group projects into sublists of a specified size, facilitating project listing with navigation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Divides a list of projects into groups of specified size, returning an array with groups and navigation indexes.
